run_score_string_text: run the score API with a string query and string document
run_score_text_image: run the score API with a string query and a text plus image document
run_score_image_video: run the score API with a string query and image or video document
run_score_list_multi: run the score API with list queries and list documents of mixed types
parse_cli_arguments: parse command line arguments for host and port to connect to the vLLM pooling server
